name: Atuy
source:
A girl with a perpetually relaxed demeanour.
Far from shy, she carries herself with confidence and an always cheery disposition. Her manner of speaking is slightly refined.
Although starry-eyed and on a constant quest for love she is also quite the master of the spear.
Her pet Kurarin can be constantly seen riding on her head.
